title: Bistable pulsating waves with periodic advection: homogenization and sharp speed asymptotics
summary: We study bistable pulsating waves for reaction-diffusion equations with general periodic advection in arbitrary space dimension, allowing the diffusion matrix to be nonsymmetric. Assuming that the homogenized equation admits a traveling wave with nonzero speed in a given direction, we construct moving pulsating waves for all sufficiently small spatial periods $L$ and prove their convergence to the homogenized wave as $L\to0^+$.
